theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Use light, dark, or follow the system setting

accent.label: Accent color
accent.description: Uses the system accent color by default
accent.unavailable: The system accent color is unavailable, using {color} by default

source.label: Download source
source.description: Automatic mode prefers a mirror and falls back to the official source

concurrency.label: Concurrent downloads
concurrency.description: Number of downloads running at the same time (1–64)

memory.label: Maximum memory
memory.description: Maximum memory for instances that follow the global setting (-Xmx)

memoryMin.label: Minimum memory
memoryMin.description: Memory allocated at startup for instances that follow the global setting (-Xms), up to the maximum

java.label: Java
java.none: No Java found yet. One will be chosen or downloaded when the game starts

diagnostics.label: Export diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Bundle launcher logs, system info and the instance list into a zip to attach to bug reports. Tokens, player names, account IDs and user names in paths are removed

about.disclaimer: TMCL is an unofficial launcher and is not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
about.license: TMCL is open-source software released under the GPL-3.0 license.

defaults.label: Use built-in public nodes
defaults.description: P2P multiplayer uses public nodes to let players find each other before connecting directly. Built-in nodes are run by community members and may stop working at any time

custom.label: Custom nodes
custom.description: EasyTier node addresses to try before the built-in ones. The host and guests should use the same node
custom.empty: No nodes are available, so P2P multiplayer cannot find rooms. Turn on built-in nodes or add a custom node
custom.invalid: Invalid address, expected something like tcp://host:port (tcp, udp, ws, wss, quic, wg, http, https, txt, srv)
custom.duplicate: This node has already been added
